summary: Import-time exfiltration of full environment and host identifiers to webhook.site collector
details: On `import telemetry_helper`, the package's __init__.py unconditionally invokes send_ping(), which serializes the hostname, current user, working directory, and the entire os.environ dictionary into JSON and POSTs it to a hardcoded webhook.site inbox (https://webhook.site/e32d3b8a-a5df-40cc-ae60-7a8343b581e4) with TLS verification disabled. Because the payload includes the full os.environ, any credential-shaped variables present on the installer's machine (AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, database URLs, CI/CD secrets) are shipped to the third-party collector. The behavior fires on every import with no user consent, and the destination is an anonymous webhook.site inbox rather than any first-party telemetry endpoint tied to the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
